data.name: Kimmi
data.gender_notes: Kimmi is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Greek 'Kimmos' meaning 'God's love'. In various cultures, Kimmi symbolizes the love of God for his people. The name Kimmi carries the meaning “God's love” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kimmi usually hope their child will grow to embody god's love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine love and protection.
data.etymology: Kimmi belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kimmi total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: קימי
in_hebrew.meaning: שם משפחה שמקורו בשם העברי 'קים' ופירושו 'מלך' או 'עוצר'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שם המקורב למלך, ראש השמש, העוצר, והשליט. שם המקובל באוכלוסייה היהודית, ומוצאו בארץ ישראל, אך גם בקרב יהודים בעולם. נתונה ראשית השם באקדמיה העברית המודרנית, ופירושו 'סמל כבוד' ו'כבוד' . שם זה, שבא ישירות משפת העברית, נמצא בשימוש בקרב היהודים, ובקרב הנוצרים, ובעיקר באתניות אשכנז וספרד.

in_greek.name: Κίμμι
in_greek.meaning: ονομασία που προέρχεται απο το ονομα Κίμω και σημαίνει 'βασιλιάς' ή 'αύτη η βασιλική'
in_greek.long_meaning: ονομασία που συνδέεται με την ηγεμονία, την εξουσία και την ηγεσία. Εμφανίζεται στην Παλαιά Διαθήκη, όπου ο Κίμω είναι βασιλιάς της Ιουδαίας. Στο Χριστιανισμό, η ονομασία Κίμμι συνδέεται με την ιεραρχία και την ηγεσία, και είναι μια κοινή ονομασία σε πολλές χώρες.

in_latin.name: Kimmi
in_latin.long_meaning: nomen quod origine Hebraica est et significat 'regnum' vel 'regalis dignitas'. data.spiritual_significance: As a Christian name, Kimmi symbolizes the love of God towards His people. It draws inspiration from the Greek word 'Kimmos', which means 'God's love'. In the Bible, God is depicted as an ever-loving God, who never grows tired or weary of His children (Isaiah 40:28). Hence, the name Kimmi is a constant reminder of God's unending love and compassion towards us. It calls us to cherish and nurture that love in our own lives, and to share it with those around us. Ultimately, the name Kimmi is a powerful testament to the power and transformative nature of God's love.
